source_policy: Only own generation and read-only saved vanilla region files. Launcher is opaque; no game code, reports or data-pack dumps used. Cached 26.1.2 search results are excluded.

reproduction.ours:
while pgrep -x cargo >/dev/null; do sleep 15; done
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 BADLANDS_OUTPUT='<new-dir>' cargo test --release export_badlands_263_chunks -- --ignored --nocapture
reproduction.measurement: tools/measure/badlands_ocean_263.py; numpy and scipy required; measure distant badlands windows separately, using their chunk selections. --columns exports vertical band layouts.
reproduction.biome_grid: cargo build --release -p seedmap-core --example biome_profile_263; executable takes a JSON plan and CSV output (same cargo guard and job limit).

ours_before.definition: Terracotta: first band within 8 blocks below terrain, contiguous depth capped at 64; run lengths and transitions use columns with >=8 contiguous layers. Hoodoo proxy: configurable morphological opening of terrain height (opening_size); 8-connected prominence>=12 components, 4..1024 columns, peak>=16. 32-block observed halo excludes truncated windows.

verification.counting: Only top-level test suites; nested one-test smoke subprocess is excluded.

limitations: Morphological spire counts are an operational proxy, not feature identifiers. Selected diagnostic patches have limited statistical power.
Ocean distances near unknown edges are censored; exact quantiles alone do not describe censored cells. Minimum observed warm-to-land-biome distance is 4 blocks in both generators.
Terrain and biome coordinates do not reproduce vanilla seed-for-seed. Broader ocean geometry and global cold/frozen area shares remain unverified.
Changes affect newly generated 26.3 chunks. Existing owner-world chunks were not rewritten.
